plain.li: The comet's moved since last night.
You can see the tail without squinting tonight.
I keep looking up to check it's still there.
[lowtech] My grandmother said a comet means a hard winter.
[!lowtech] Someone should be writing down where it is each night.
[winter] Too cold to stand out here, and I'm standing out here anyway.
[child] Is it going to fall on us?

warm.li: Come and look, it's brighter tonight.
Wake the others, they'll want to see this.

blunt.li: It's a rock with a tail.
Pretty. Now I'm going to bed.

cheerful.li: Look at the tail on it!
Quick, make a wish before it moves.

gloomy.li: Nothing good ever came with a comet.
It looks like a cut in the sky.

cold.li: It's moved a finger's width since yesterday.

plain.li: The fireflies are thick over the long grass tonight.
There's one on my sleeve.
They come out right when the light goes.
[summer] Warm night for it.
[child] I caught one, and it's still blinking in my hands.

warm.li: Walk slowly, you'll see more of them.

cheerful.li: There must be hundreds out tonight.

gloomy.li: They'll be gone in a week.

cold.li: They light up to find a mate, that's all it is.

plain.li: That one hit me right on the ear.
The crops are taking a beating out there.
Get under a roof, it's hailing.
[lowtech] Get the seed baskets under cover.

warm.li: Inside, all of you, before it gets worse.

cheerful.li: Some of these are as big as eggs!

cold.li: The fields will lose a few days of growth.

plain.li: Warm enough to work without a coat.
[spring] Feels like summer came early.
[fall] Strange to be sweating this late in the year.
[work:Growing] The seedlings are loving this.

warm.li: Days like this make up for the cold ones.

blunt.li: Too warm for this time of year.

cold.li: The crops will like this warm air.

plain.li: That's the last of them.
Anyone hurt? Shout if you are.
My hands won't stop shaking.
[!lowtech] Check your ammo, then check the wounded.
[lowtech] Gather up the arrows before dark.

warm.li: Thank you for standing with me.

cheerful.li: Ha, they won't try that again!

cold.li: Drag the bodies off before they start to smell.

plain.li: Wouldn't miss {TRADITION} for anything.
Same as last year, and the year before.
I saved my good shirt for {TRADITION}.
[child] Is it time for {TRADITION} already?

cheerful.li: I've been looking forward to this all season.

cold.li: It keeps people together, I suppose.
